changeSet.createView: WITH base AS ( SELECT l.id AS loan_id, COALESCE(l.office_id, c.office_id, g.office_id) AS current_office_id, CASE WHEN l.is_migrated = TRUE AND l.migrated_on_date IS NOT NULL AND l.migrated_from_office_id IS NOT NULL THEN l.migrated_on_date WHEN c.is_migrated = TRUE AND c.migrated_on_date IS NOT NULL AND c.migrated_from_office_id IS NOT NULL THEN c.migrated_on_date END AS migrated_on_date, CASE WHEN l.is_migrated = TRUE AND l.migrated_on_date IS NOT NULL AND l.migrated_from_office_id IS NOT NULL THEN l.migrated_from_office_id WHEN c.is_migrated = TRUE AND c.migrated_on_date IS NOT NULL AND c.migrated_from_office_id IS NOT NULL THEN c.migrated_from_office_id END AS migrated_from_office_id FROM m_loan l LEFT JOIN m_client c ON c.id = l.client_id LEFT JOIN m_group g ON g.id = l.group_id ), period AS ( SELECT loan_id, migrated_from_office_id AS office_id, DATE '1900-01-01' AS valid_from, migrated_on_date AS valid_to FROM base WHERE migrated_on_date IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT loan_id, current_office_id, COALESCE(migrated_on_date, DATE '1900-01-01'), DATE '9999-12-31' FROM base ), kc_map AS ( SELECT kc.id AS kc_office_id, COALESCE(ke.id, ker.id) AS ke_office_id FROM m_office kcr JOIN m_office kc ON kc.hierarchy LIKE CONCAT(kcr.hierarchy, '%') JOIN m_office ker ON ker.name = 'Inkomoko - Kenya' LEFT JOIN m_office ke ON ke.hierarchy LIKE CONCAT(ker.hierarchy, '_%') AND ke.name = TRIM(SUBSTRING(kc.name, 4)) WHERE kcr.name = 'Inkomoko - Capital Kenya Limited' ) SELECT p.loan_id, p.office_id, p.valid_from, p.valid_to FROM period p LEFT JOIN kc_map k ON k.kc_office_id = p.office_id WHERE k.kc_office_id IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT p.loan_id, k.ke_office_id, p.valid_from, LEAST(p.valid_to, DATE '2026-06-01') FROM period p JOIN kc_map k ON k.kc_office_id = p.office_id WHERE p.valid_from < DATE '2026-06-01' UNION ALL SELECT p.loan_id, p.office_id, GREATEST(p.valid_from, DATE '2026-06-01'), p.valid_to FROM period p JOIN kc_map k ON k.kc_office_id = p.office_id WHERE p.valid_to > DATE '2026-06-01'

preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM stretchy_report WHERE report_name = 'Active Loans - Details'

update.column:
select concat(repeat("..", ((LENGTH(ounder.`hierarchy`) - LENGTH(REPLACE(ounder.`hierarchy`, '.', '')) - 1))), ounder.`name`) as "Office/Branch", ifnull(cur.display_symbol, l.currency_code) as Currency, lo.display_name as "Loan Officer", c.display_name as "Client", l.account_no as "Loan Account No.", pl.`name` as "Product", f.`name` as Fund, l.principal_amount as "Loan Amount", l.annual_nominal_interest_rate as " Annual Nominal Interest Rate", date(l.disbursedon_date) as "Disbursed Date", date(l.expected_maturedon_date) as "Expected Matured On",
l.principal_repaid_derived as "Principal Repaid", l.principal_outstanding_derived as "Principal Outstanding", laa.principal_overdue_derived as "Principal Overdue",
l.interest_repaid_derived as "Interest Repaid", l.interest_outstanding_derived as "Interest Outstanding", laa.interest_overdue_derived as "Interest Overdue",
l.fee_charges_repaid_derived as "Fees Repaid", l.fee_charges_outstanding_derived as "Fees Outstanding", laa.fee_charges_overdue_derived as "Fees Overdue",
l.penalty_charges_repaid_derived as "Penalties Repaid", l.penalty_charges_outstanding_derived as "Penalties Outstanding", penalty_charges_overdue_derived as "Penalties Overdue"
from m_loan l join m_client c on c.id = l.client_id JOIN m_office ounder ON ounder.id = ( SELECT eo.office_id FROM v_loan_entity_office eo WHERE eo.loan_id = l.id AND CURDATE() >= eo.valid_from AND CURDATE() < eo.valid_to) JOIN m_office o ON o.id = ${officeId} AND ounder.hierarchy LIKE CONCAT(o.hierarchy, '%') AND ounder.hierarchy LIKE CONCAT('${currentUserHierarchy}', '%') join m_product_loan pl on pl.id = l.product_id left join m_staff lo on lo.id = l.loan_officer_id left join m_currency cur on cur.code = l.currency_code left join m_fund f on f.id = l.fund_id left join m_loan_arrears_aging laa on laa.loan_id = l.id where 1 = 1 and (l.currency_code = "${currencyId}" or "-1" = "${currencyId}") and (l.product_id = "${loanProductId}" or "-1" = "${loanProductId}") and (ifnull(l.loan_officer_id, -10) = "${loanOfficerId}" or "-1" = "${loanOfficerId}") and (ifnull(l.fund_id, -10) = ${fundId} or -1 = ${fundId}) and (ifnull(l.loanpurpose_cv_id, -10) = ${loanPurposeId} or -1 = ${loanPurposeId}) and l.loan_status_id = 300 group by l.id, ounder.id, ounder.hierarchy, ounder.`name` order by ounder.hierarchy, l.currency_code, c.account_no, l.account_no

preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM stretchy_report WHERE report_name = 'Obligation Met Loans Details'

update.column: select concat(repeat('..', ((LENGTH(ounder.hierarchy) - LENGTH(REPLACE(ounder.hierarchy, '.', '')) - 1))), ounder.name) as 'Office/Branch', ifnull(cur.display_symbol, l.currency_code) as 'Currency', c.account_no as 'Client Account No.', c.display_name as 'Client', l.account_no as 'Loan Account No.', pl.name as 'Product', f.name as 'Fund', l.principal_amount as 'Loan Amount', l.total_repayment_derived as 'Total Repaid', l.annual_nominal_interest_rate as 'Annual Nominal Interest Rate', date(l.disbursedon_date) as 'Disbursed', date(l.closedon_date) as 'Closed', l.principal_repaid_derived as 'Principal Repaid', l.interest_repaid_derived as 'Interest Repaid', l.fee_charges_repaid_derived as 'Fees Repaid', l.penalty_charges_repaid_derived as 'Penalties Repaid', lo.display_name as 'Loan Officer', cvl.code_value as 'Location', l.generic_loan_counter as 'Cycle' from m_loan l join m_client c on c.id = l.client_id JOIN m_office ounder ON ounder.id = ( SELECT eo.office_id FROM v_loan_entity_office eo WHERE eo.loan_id = l.id AND l.closedon_date >= eo.valid_from AND l.closedon_date < eo.valid_to) JOIN m_office o ON o.id = ${officeId} AND ounder.hierarchy LIKE CONCAT(o.hierarchy, '%') AND ounder.hierarchy LIKE CONCAT('${currentUserHierarchy}', '%') join m_product_loan pl on pl.id = l.product_id left join m_staff lo on lo.id = l.loan_officer_id left join m_currency cur on cur.code = l.currency_code left join m_fund f on f.id = l.fund_id left join m_client_recruitment_survey crs on crs.client_id = c.id left join m_code_value cvl on cvl.id = l.currency_code, c.account_no, l.account_no

preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM stretchy_report WHERE report_name = 'Portfolio at Risk'

update.column:
select x.Currency, x.`Principal Outstanding`, x.`Principal Overdue`, x.`Interest Outstanding`, x.`Interest Overdue`, x.`Fees Outstanding`, x.`Fees Overdue`, x.`Penalties Outstanding`, x.`Penalties Overdue`,
(case when ${parType} = 1 then cast(round((x.`Principal Overdue` * 100) / x.`Principal Outstanding`, 2) as char) when ${parType} = 2 then cast(round(((x.`Principal Overdue` + x.`Interest Overdue`) * 100) / (x.`Principal Outstanding` + x.`Interest Outstanding`), 2) as char) when ${parType} = 3 then cast(round(((x.`Principal Overdue` + x.`Interest Overdue` + x.`Fees Overdue`) * 100) / (x.`Principal Outstanding` + x.`Interest Outstanding` + x.`Fees Outstanding`), 2) as char) when ${parType} = 4 then cast(round(((x.`Principal Overdue` + x.`Interest Overdue` + x.`Fees Overdue` + x.`Penalties Overdue`) * 100) / (x.`Principal Outstanding` + x.`Interest Outstanding` + x.`Fees Outstanding` + x.`Penalties Overdue`), 2) as char) else "invalid PAR Type" end) as "Portfolio at Risk %" from (select ifnull(cur.display_symbol, l.currency_code) as Currency, sum(l.principal_outstanding_derived) as "Principal Outstanding", sum(laa.principal_overdue_derived) as "Principal Overdue",
sum(l.interest_outstanding_derived) as "Interest Outstanding", sum(laa.interest_overdue_derived) as "Interest Overdue",
sum(l.fee_charges_outstanding_derived) as "Fees Outstanding", sum(laa.fee_charges_overdue_derived) as "Fees Overdue",
sum(penalty_charges_outstanding_derived) as "Penalties Outstanding", sum(laa.penalty_charges_overdue_derived) as "Penalties Overdue"
from m_loan l join m_client c on c.id = l.client_id JOIN m_office ounder ON ounder.id = ( SELECT eo.office_id FROM v_loan_entity_office eo WHERE eo.loan_id = l.id AND CURDATE() >= eo.valid_from AND CURDATE() < eo.valid_to) JOIN m_office o ON o.id = ${officeId} AND ounder.hierarchy LIKE CONCAT(o.hierarchy, '%') AND ounder.hierarchy LIKE CONCAT('${currentUserHierarchy}', '%') left join m_staff lo on lo.id = l.loan_officer_id left join m_currency cur on cur.code = l.currency_code left join m_fund f on f.id = l.fund_id left join m_code_value purp on purp.id = l.loanpurpose_cv_id left join m_product_loan p on p.id = l.product_id left join m_loan_arrears_aging laa on laa.loan_id = l.id where 1 = 1 and (l.currency_code = "${currencyId}" or "-1" = "${currencyId}") and (l.product_id = "${loanProductId}" or "-1" = "${loanProductId}") and (ifnull(l.loan_officer_id, -10) = "${loanOfficerId}" or "-1" = "${loanOfficerId}") and (ifnull(l.fund_id, -10) = ${fundId} or -1 = ${fundId}) and (ifnull(l.loanpurpose_cv_id, -10) = ${loanPurposeId} or -1 = ${loanPurposeId}) and l.loan_status_id = 300 group by l.currency_code order by l.currency_code) x

preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM stretchy_report WHERE report_name = 'Portfolio at Risk by Branch'

update.column:
select concat(repeat("..", ((LENGTH(mo.`hierarchy`) - LENGTH(REPLACE(mo.`hierarchy`, '.', '')) - 1))), mo.`name`) as "Office/Branch", x.Currency, x.`Principal Outstanding`, x.`Principal Overdue`, x.`Interest Outstanding`, x.`Interest Overdue`, x.`Fees Outstanding`, x.`Fees Overdue`, x.`Penalties Outstanding`, x.`Penalties Overdue`,
(case when ${parType} = 1 then cast(round((x.`Principal Overdue` * 100) / x.`Principal Outstanding`, 2) as char) when ${parType} = 2 then cast(round(((x.`Principal Overdue` + x.`Interest Overdue`) * 100) / (x.`Principal Outstanding` + x.`Interest Outstanding`), 2) as char) when ${parType} = 3 then cast(round(((x.`Principal Overdue` + x.`Interest Overdue` + x.`Fees Overdue`) * 100) / (x.`Principal Outstanding` + x.`Interest Outstanding` + x.`Fees Outstanding`), 2) as char) when ${parType} = 4 then cast(round(((x.`Principal Overdue` + x.`Interest Overdue` + x.`Fees Overdue` + x.`Penalties Overdue`) * 100) / (x.`Principal Outstanding` + x.`Interest Outstanding` + x.`Fees Outstanding` + x.`Penalties Overdue`), 2) as char) else "invalid PAR Type" end) as "Portfolio at Risk %" from m_office mo join (select ounder.id as "branch", ifnull(cur.display_symbol, l.currency_code) as Currency,
sum(l.principal_outstanding_derived) as "Principal Outstanding", sum(laa.principal_overdue_derived) as "Principal Overdue",
sum(l.interest_outstanding_derived) as "Interest Outstanding", sum(laa.interest_overdue_derived) as "Interest Overdue",
sum(l.fee_charges_outstanding_derived) as "Fees Outstanding", sum(laa.fee_charges_overdue_derived) as "Fees Overdue",
sum(penalty_charges_outstanding_derived) as "Penalties Outstanding", sum(laa.penalty_charges_overdue_derived) as "Penalties Overdue"
from m_loan l join m_client c on c.id = l.client_id JOIN m_office ounder ON ounder.id = ( SELECT eo.office_id FROM v_loan_entity_office eo WHERE eo.loan_id = l.id AND CURDATE() >= eo.valid_from AND CURDATE() < eo.valid_to) JOIN m_office o ON o.id = ${officeId} AND ounder.hierarchy LIKE CONCAT(o.hierarchy, '%') AND ounder.hierarchy LIKE CONCAT('${currentUserHierarchy}', '%') left join m_staff lo on lo.id = l.loan_officer_id left join m_currency cur on cur.code = l.currency_code left join m_fund f on f.id = l.fund_id left join m_code_value purp on purp.id = l.loanpurpose_cv_id left join m_product_loan p on p.id = l.product_id left join m_loan_arrears_aging laa on laa.loan_id = l.id where 1 = 1 and (l.currency_code = "${currencyId}" or "-1" = "${currencyId}") and (l.product_id = "${loanProductId}" or "-1" = "${loanProductId}") and (ifnull(l.loan_officer_id, -10) = "${loanOfficerId}" or "-1" = "${loanOfficerId}") and (ifnull(l.fund_id, -10) = ${fundId} or -1 = ${fundId}) and (ifnull(l.loanpurpose_cv_id, -10) = ${loanPurposeId} or -1 = ${loanPurposeId}) and l.loan_status_id = 300 group by ounder.id, l.currency_code) x on x.branch = mo.id order by mo.hierarchy, x.Currency

preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM stretchy_report WHERE report_name = 'Funds Disbursed Between Dates Summary by Office'

update.column:
select concat(repeat("..", ((LENGTH(ounder.`hierarchy`) - LENGTH(REPLACE(ounder.`hierarchy`, '.', '')) - 1))), ounder.`name`) as "Office/Branch",
ifnull(f.`name`, '-') as Fund, ifnull(cur.display_symbol, l.currency_code) as Currency, round(sum(l.principal_amount), 4) as disbursed_amount from m_loan l join m_client c on c.id = l.client_id JOIN m_office ounder ON ounder.id = ( SELECT eo.office_id FROM v_loan_entity_office eo WHERE eo.loan_id = l.id AND l.disbursedon_date >= eo.valid_from AND l.disbursedon_date < eo.valid_to) JOIN m_office o ON o.id = ${officeId} AND ounder.hierarchy LIKE CONCAT(o.hierarchy, '%') AND ounder.hierarchy LIKE CONCAT('${currentUserHierarchy}', '%') join m_currency cur on cur.`code` = l.currency_code left join m_fund f on f.id = l.fund_id
where disbursedon_date between '${startDate}' and '${endDate}' and (ifnull(l.fund_id, -10) = ${fundId} or -1 = ${fundId}) and
(l.currency_code = '${currencyId}' or '-1' = '${currencyId}') group by ounder.id, ounder.hierarchy, ounder.`name`, ifnull(f.`name`, '-') , ifnull(cur.display_symbol,
l.currency_code) order by ounder.`name`, ifnull(f.`name`, '-') , ifnull(cur.display_symbol, l.currency_code)
update.where: report_name = 'Funds Disbursed Between Dates Summary by Office'

preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM stretchy_report WHERE report_name = 'Written-Off Loans'

update.column: SELECT concat(repeat('..', ((LENGTH(ounder.`hierarchy`) - LENGTH(REPLACE(ounder.`hierarchy`, '.', '')) - 1))), ounder.`name`) as 'Office/Branch', ifnull(cur.display_symbol, ml.currency_code) as Currency, c.account_no as 'Client Account No.', c.display_name AS 'Client Name', ml.account_no AS 'Loan Account No.', mpl.name AS 'Product Name', ml.disbursedon_date AS 'Disbursed Date', lt.transaction_date AS 'Written Off date', ml.principal_amount as 'Loan Amount', ifnull(lt.principal_portion_derived, 0) AS 'Written-Off Principal', ifnull(lt.interest_portion_derived, 0) AS 'Written-Off Interest', ifnull(lt.fee_charges_portion_derived,0) AS 'Written-Off Fees', ifnull(lt.penalty_charges_portion_derived,0) AS 'Written-Off Penalties', n.note AS 'Reason For Write-Off', IFNULL(ms.display_name,'-') AS 'Loan Officer Name', year(now()) - YEAR(c.date_of_birth) as 'Age', c.external_id as 'Client UID', cdg.code_value as 'Gender', cvc.code_value as 'Cohort', ml.loan_counter as 'Cycle', cvn.code_value as 'Nationality', cvl.code_value as 'Location', cvs.code_value as 'Strata' FROM m_loan_transaction lt JOIN m_loan ml ON ml.id = lt.loan_id JOIN m_client c ON c.id = ml.client_id JOIN m_office ounder ON ounder.id = ( SELECT eo.office_id FROM v_loan_entity_office eo WHERE eo.loan_id = ml.id AND lt.transaction_date >= eo.valid_from AND lt.transaction_date < eo.valid_to) JOIN m_office o ON o.id = ${officeId} AND ounder.hierarchy like concat(o.hierarchy, '%') AND ounder.hierarchy like CONCAT('${currentUserHierarchy}', '%') JOIN m_product_loan mpl ON mpl.id=ml.product_id LEFT JOIN m_staff ms ON ms.id=ml.loan_officer_id LEFT JOIN m_note n ON n.loan_transaction_id = lt.id LEFT JOIN m_currency cur on cur.code = ml.currency_code left join m_client_other_info coi on coi.client_id = c.id left join m_code_value cdg on cdg.id = c.gender_cv_id left join m_client_recruitment_survey crs on crs.client_id = c.id left join m_code_value cvc on cvc.id = crs.cohort_cv_id left join m_code_value cvn on cvn.id = coi.nationality_cv_id left join m_code_value cvl on cvl.id = crs.survey_location_cv_id left join m_code_value cvs on cvs.id = coi.strata_cv_id WHERE lt.transaction_type_enum = 6 AND lt.is_reversed is false AND ml.loan_status_id=601 AND (mpl.id=${loanProductId} OR ${loanProductId}=-1) AND lt.transaction_date BETWEEN '${startDate}' AND '${endDate}' AND (ml.currency_code = '${currencyId}' or '-1' = '${currencyId}') ORDER BY ounder.hierarchy, ifnull(cur.display_symbol, ml.currency_code), ml.account_no

l.fee_charges_repaid_derived as "Fees Repaid", l.fee_charges_outstanding_derived as "Fees Outstanding", laa.fee_charges_overdue_derived as "Fees Overdue",
l.penalty_charges_repaid_derived as "Penalties Repaid", l.penalty_charges_outstanding_derived as "Penalties Outstanding", laa.penalty_charges_overdue_derived as "Penalties Overdue"
from m_loan l join m_client c on c.id = l.client_id JOIN m_office ounder ON ounder.id = ( SELECT eo.office_id FROM v_loan_entity_office eo WHERE eo.loan_id = l.id AND CURDATE() >= eo.valid_from AND CURDATE() < eo.valid_to) JOIN m_office o ON o.id = ${officeId} AND ounder.hierarchy LIKE CONCAT(o.hierarchy, '%') AND ounder.hierarchy LIKE CONCAT('${currentUserHierarchy}', '%') join m_product_loan pl on pl.id = l.product_id left join m_staff lo on lo.id = l.loan_officer_id left join m_currency cur on cur.code = l.currency_code left join m_fund f on f.id = l.fund_id left join m_loan_arrears_aging laa on laa.loan_id = l.id where 1 = 1 and (l.currency_code = "${currencyId}" or "-1" = "${currencyId}") and (l.product_id = "${loanProductId}" or "-1" = "${loanProductId}") and (ifnull(l.loan_officer_id, -10) = "${loanOfficerId}" or "-1" = "${loanOfficerId}") and (ifnull(l.fund_id, -10) = ${fundId} or -1 = ${fundId}) and (ifnull(l.loanpurpose_cv_id, -10) = ${loanPurposeId} or -1 = ${loanPurposeId}) and l.loan_status_id = 300 and l.expected_maturedon_date < curdate() group by l.id, ounder.id, ounder.hierarchy, ounder.`name` order by ounder.hierarchy, l.currency_code, c.account_no, l.account_no

preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM stretchy_report WHERE report_name = 'Active Loans in last installment'

select concat(repeat("..", ((LENGTH(lastInstallment.`hierarchy`) - LENGTH(REPLACE(lastInstallment.`hierarchy`, '.', '')) - 1))), lastInstallment.branch) as "Office/Branch", lastInstallment.Currency, lastInstallment.`Loan Officer`, lastInstallment.`Client Account No`, lastInstallment.`Client`, lastInstallment.`Loan Account No`, lastInstallment.`Product`, lastInstallment.`Fund`, lastInstallment.`Loan Amount`, lastInstallment.`Annual Nominal Interest Rate`, lastInstallment.`Disbursed`, lastInstallment.`Expected Matured On` ,

from (select l.id as loanId, l.number_of_repayments, min(r.installment), ounder.id, ounder.hierarchy, ounder.`name` as branch, ifnull(cur.display_symbol, l.currency_code) as Currency, lo.display_name as "Loan Officer", c.account_no as "Client Account No", c.display_name as "Client", l.account_no as "Loan Account No", pl.`name` as "Product", f.`name` as Fund, l.principal_amount as "Loan Amount", l.annual_nominal_interest_rate as "Annual Nominal Interest Rate", date(l.disbursedon_date) as "Disbursed", date(l.expected_maturedon_date) as "Expected Matured On" from m_loan l join m_client c on c.id = l.client_id JOIN m_office ounder ON ounder.id = ( SELECT eo.office_id FROM v_loan_entity_office eo WHERE eo.loan_id = l.id AND CURDATE() >= eo.valid_from AND CURDATE() < eo.valid_to) JOIN m_office o ON o.id = ${officeId} AND ounder.hierarchy LIKE CONCAT(o.hierarchy, '%') AND ounder.hierarchy LIKE CONCAT('${currentUserHierarchy}', '%') join m_product_loan pl on pl.id = l.product_id left join m_staff lo on lo.id = l.loan_officer_id left join m_currency cur on cur.code = l.currency_code left join m_fund f on f.id = l.fund_id left join m_loan_repayment_schedule r on r.loan_id = l.id where 1 = 1 and (l.currency_code = "${currencyId}" or "-1" = "${currencyId}") and (l.product_id = "${loanProductId}" or "-1" = "${loanProductId}") and (ifnull(l.loan_officer_id, -10) = "${loanOfficerId}" or "-1" = "${loanOfficerId}") and (ifnull(l.fund_id, -10) = ${fundId} or -1 = ${fundId}) and (ifnull(l.loanpurpose_cv_id, -10) = ${loanPurposeId} or -1 = ${loanPurposeId}) and l.loan_status_id = 300 and r.completed_derived is false and r.duedate >= curdate() group by l.id, ounder.id, ounder.hierarchy, ounder.`name` having l.number_of_repayments = min(r.installment)) lastInstallment join m_loan l on l.id = lastInstallment.loanId left join m_loan_arrears_aging laa on laa.loan_id = l.id order by lastInstallment.hierarchy, lastInstallment.Currency, lastInstallment.`Client Account No`, lastInstallment.`Loan Account No`

preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM stretchy_report WHERE report_name = 'Active Loans by Disbursal Period'

update.column:
select concat(repeat("..", ((LENGTH(ounder.`hierarchy`) - LENGTH(REPLACE(ounder.`hierarchy`, '.', '')) - 1))), ounder.`name`) as "Office/Branch", ifnull(cur.display_symbol, l.currency_code) as Currency, c.account_no as "Client Account No", c.display_name as "Client", l.account_no as "Loan Account No", pl.`name` as "Product", f.`name` as Fund, l.principal_amount as "Loan Principal Amount", l.annual_nominal_interest_rate as " Annual Nominal Interest Rate", date(l.disbursedon_date) as "Disbursed Date",
l.total_expected_repayment_derived as "Total Loan (P+I+F+Pen)", l.total_repayment_derived as "Total Repaid (P+I+F+Pen)", lo.display_name as "Loan Officer"
from m_loan l join m_client c on c.id = l.client_id JOIN m_office ounder ON ounder.id = ( SELECT eo.office_id FROM v_loan_entity_office eo WHERE eo.loan_id = l.id AND l.disbursedon_date >= eo.valid_from AND l.disbursedon_date < eo.valid_to) JOIN m_office o ON o.id = ${officeId} AND ounder.hierarchy LIKE CONCAT(o.hierarchy, '%') AND ounder.hierarchy LIKE CONCAT('${currentUserHierarchy}', '%') join m_product_loan pl on pl.id = l.product_id left join m_staff lo on lo.id = l.loan_officer_id left join m_currency cur on cur.code = l.currency_code left join m_fund f on f.id = l.fund_id left join m_loan_arrears_aging laa on laa.loan_id = l.id where 1 = 1 and (l.currency_code = "${currencyId}" or "-1" = "${currencyId}") and (l.product_id = "${loanProductId}" or "-1" = "${loanProductId}") and (ifnull(l.loan_officer_id, -10) = "${loanOfficerId}" or "-1" = "${loanOfficerId}") and (ifnull(l.fund_id, -10) = ${fundId} or -1 = ${fundId}) and (ifnull(l.loanpurpose_cv_id, -10) = ${loanPurposeId} or -1 = ${loanPurposeId}) and l.disbursedon_date between '${startDate}' and '${endDate}' and l.loan_status_id = 300 group by l.id, ounder.id, ounder.hierarchy, ounder.`name` order by ounder.hierarchy, l.currency_code, c.account_no, l.account_no

preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM stretchy_report WHERE report_name = 'Disbursal Report'

update.column: select concat(repeat('..', ((LENGTH(ounder.hierarchy) - LENGTH(REPLACE(ounder.hierarchy, '.', '')) - 1))), ounder.name) as 'Office/Branch', ifnull(cur.display_symbol, l.currency_code) as 'Currency', c.account_no as 'Client Account No.', c.display_name as 'Client', l.account_no as 'Loan Account No.', pl.name as 'Product', ifnull(f.name, '-') as 'Fund', ifnull(lo.display_name, '-') as 'Loan Officer', l.principal_amount as 'Loan Amount', dt.transaction_date as 'Disbursement Date', dt.amount as 'Disbursed Amount', rev.enum_message_property as 'Loan Status', dt.id as 'Transaction ID' from m_loan_transaction dt join m_loan l on l.id = dt.loan_id join m_client c on c.id = l.client_id JOIN m_office ounder ON ounder.id = ( SELECT eo.office_id FROM v_loan_entity_office eo WHERE eo.loan_id = l.id AND dt.transaction_date >= eo.valid_from AND dt.transaction_date < eo.valid_to) JOIN m_office o ON o.id = ${officeId} AND ounder.hierarchy LIKE CONCAT(o.hierarchy, '%') AND ounder.hierarchy LIKE CONCAT('${currentUserHierarchy}', '%') join m_product_loan pl on pl.id = l.product_id left join m_fund f on f.id = l.fund_id left join m_staff lo on lo.id = l.loan_officer_id left join m_currency cur on cur.code = l.currency_code left join r_enum_value rev on rev.enum_name = 'loan_status_id' and rev.enum_id = l.loan_status_id where dt.transaction_type_enum = 1 and dt.is_reversed = 0 and dt.transaction_date between '${startDate}' and '${endDate}' order by ounder.hierarchy, l.currency_code, dt.transaction_date, l.account_no

preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM stretchy_report WHERE report_name = 'Loan payments received (Overdue Loans)'

update.column: SELECT ml.id AS "loanId", mc.id AS "id", mc.firstname AS "firstName", mc.middlename AS "middleName", mc.lastname AS "lastName", mc.display_name AS "fullName", mc.mobile_no AS "mobileNo", ml.principal_amount AS "loanAmount", (IFNULL(ml.principal_outstanding_derived, 0) + IFNULL(ml.interest_outstanding_derived, 0) + IFNULL(ml.fee_charges_outstanding_derived, 0) + IFNULL(ml.penalty_charges_outstanding_derived, 0)) AS "loanOutstanding", ounder.id AS "officeNumber", ml.account_no AS "loanAccountNumber", SUM(lt.amount) AS "repaymentAmount" FROM m_loan ml INNER JOIN m_client mc ON mc.id = ml.client_id JOIN m_office ounder ON ounder.id = ( SELECT eo.office_id FROM v_loan_entity_office eo WHERE eo.loan_id = ml.id AND CURDATE() >= eo.valid_from AND CURDATE() < eo.valid_to) JOIN m_office mo ON mo.id = ${officeId} AND ounder.hierarchy LIKE CONCAT(mo.hierarchy, '%') INNER JOIN r_enum_value rev ON rev.enum_id=ml.loan_status_id AND rev.enum_name = 'loan_status_id' INNER JOIN m_loan_arrears_aging laa ON laa.loan_id=ml.id INNER JOIN m_loan_transaction lt ON lt.loan_id = ml.id INNER JOIN m_appuser au ON au.id = lt.created_by LEFT JOIN m_payment_detail mpd ON mpd.id=lt.payment_detail_id LEFT JOIN m_currency cur ON cur.code = ml.currency_code LEFT JOIN m_group_client gc ON gc.client_id = mc.id LEFT JOIN m_group g ON g.id = gc.group_id LEFT JOIN m_staff lo ON lo.id = ml.loan_officer_id LEFT JOIN m_guarantor gua ON gua.loan_id = ml.id WHERE ml.loan_status_id=300 AND (IFNULL(ml.loan_officer_id, -10) = ${loanOfficerId} OR "-1" = ${loanOfficerId}) AND (DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), lt.transaction_date) BETWEEN ${fromX} AND ${toY}) AND (DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), laa.overdue_since_date_derived) BETWEEN ${overdueX} AND ${overdueY}) AND lt.is_reversed=0 AND lt.transaction_type_enum=2 GROUP BY ml.id, ounder.id, ounder.hierarchy ORDER BY ounder.hierarchy, ml.currency_code, mc.account_no, ml.account_no

preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM stretchy_report WHERE report_name = 'Loan in arrears Table'

update.column: select mc.id AS 'ID', mc.firstname AS 'First Name', mc.middlename AS 'Middle Name', mc.lastname AS 'Last Name', mc.display_name AS 'Full Name', mc.mobile_no AS 'Mobile No', ml.principal_amount AS 'Loan Amount', (IFNULL(ml.principal_outstanding_derived, 0) + IFNULL(ml.interest_outstanding_derived, 0) + IFNULL(ml.fee_charges_outstanding_derived, 0) + IFNULL(ml.penalty_charges_outstanding_derived, 0)) AS 'Loan Outstanding', ml.principal_disbursed_derived AS 'Loan Disbursed', laa.overdue_since_date_derived AS 'Payment Due Date', IFNULL(laa.total_overdue_derived, 0) AS 'Total Due', ounder.id AS 'Office Number', ml.account_no AS 'Account Number', gua.lastname AS 'Guarantor Last Name', COUNT(gua.id) AS 'Number Of Guarantors', g.display_name AS 'Group Name', year(now()) - YEAR(mc.date_of_birth) as 'Age', mc.external_id as 'Client UID', cdg.code_value as 'Gender', cvc.code_value as 'Cohort', ml.generic_loan_counter as 'Cycle', cvn.code_value as 'Nationality', cvl.code_value as 'Location', cvs.code_value as 'Strata' FROM m_loan ml INNER JOIN m_client mc ON mc.id = ml.client_id JOIN m_office ounder ON ounder.id = ( SELECT eo.office_id FROM v_loan_entity_office eo WHERE eo.loan_id = ml.id AND DATE('${endDate}') >= eo.valid_from AND DATE('${endDate}') < eo.valid_to) JOIN m_office mo ON mo.id = ${officeId} AND ounder.hierarchy LIKE CONCAT(mo.hierarchy, '%') INNER JOIN r_enum_value rev ON rev.enum_id = ml.loan_status_id AND rev.enum_name = 'loan_status_id' INNER JOIN m_loan_arrears_aging laa ON laa.loan_id = ml.id LEFT JOIN m_currency cur ON cur.code = ml.currency_code LEFT JOIN m_group_client gc ON gc.client_id = mc.id LEFT JOIN m_group g ON g.id = gc.group_id LEFT JOIN m_staff lo ON lo.id = ml.loan_officer_id LEFT JOIN m_guarantor gua ON gua.loan_id = ml.id left join m_client_other_info coi on coi.client_id = mc.id left join m_code_value cdg on cdg.id = mc.gender_cv_id left join m_client_recruitment_survey crs on crs.client_id = mc.id left join m_code_value cvc on cvc.id = crs.cohort_cv_id left join m_code_value cvn on cvn.id = coi.nationality_cv_id left join m_code_value cvl on cvl.id = crs.survey_location_cv_id left join m_code_value cvs on cvs.id = coi.strata_cv_id WHERE ml.loan_status_id = 300 AND (IFNULL(ml.loan_officer_id, -10) = ${loanOfficerId} OR '-1' = '${loanOfficerId}') AND date(laa.overdue_since_date_derived) between date('${startDate}') and date('${endDate}') GROUP BY ml.id, ounder.id, ounder.hierarchy, ml.currency_code, mc.account_no, ml.account_no, gua.lastname, g.display_name, cvc.code_value, cvn.code_value, cvl.code_value, cvs.code_value ORDER BY ounder.hierarchy, ml.currency_code, mc.account_no, ml.account_no

preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM stretchy_report WHERE report_name = 'Loan Payment Details Report'

update.column: SELECT ml.account_no AS 'Account Number/Loan ID', mc.display_name AS 'Client Name', mc.id AS 'Client ID', mo.name AS 'Office', lp.name AS 'Loan Product', pt.value AS 'Payment Type', ml.currency_code AS 'Currency', mlt.id AS 'Transaction ID', mlt.transaction_date AS 'Transaction Date', mlt.amount AS 'Total Amount Paid', COALESCE(mlt.principal_portion_derived,0) AS 'Principal Paid', COALESCE(mlt.interest_portion_derived,0) AS 'Interest Paid', ( COALESCE(mlt.fee_charges_portion_derived,0) + COALESCE(mlt.penalty_charges_portion_derived,0) + COALESCE(mlt.overpayment_portion_derived,0) + COALESCE(mlt.unrecognized_income_portion,0) ) AS 'Charges & Others Paid', cvp.code_value AS 'Province', adr.physical_address_sector AS 'Sector', adr.physical_address_cell AS 'Cell', adr.physical_address_district AS 'District', mpd.receipt_number AS 'Reference Number', mpd.routing_code AS 'Payment Hub Transaction ID', MIN(creator.username) AS 'Created By', MIN(gl.created_date) AS 'Created On', CASE WHEN mlt.is_reversed = 1 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS 'Is Reversed', CASE WHEN mlt.is_reversed = 1 THEN MAX(rev_by.username) ELSE NULL END AS 'Reversed By', CASE WHEN mlt.is_reversed = 1 THEN MAX(gl.created_date) ELSE NULL END AS 'Reversed On' FROM m_loan ml JOIN m_client mc ON ml.client_id = mc.id JOIN m_product_loan lp ON ml.product_id = lp.id JOIN m_loan_transaction mlt ON ml.id = mlt.loan_id JOIN m_office mo ON mo.id = ( SELECT eo.office_id FROM v_loan_entity_office eo WHERE eo.loan_id = ml.id AND mlt.transaction_date >= eo.valid_from AND mlt.transaction_date < eo.valid_to) JOIN m_payment_detail mpd ON mlt.payment_detail_id = mpd.id LEFT JOIN m_payment_type pt ON mpd.payment_type_id = pt.id LEFT JOIN acc_gl_journal_entry gl ON gl.loan_transaction_id = mlt.id LEFT JOIN m_appuser creator ON gl.created_date = ( SELECT MIN(gl2.created_date) FROM acc_gl_journal_entry gl2 WHERE gl2.loan_transaction_id = mlt.id ) AND gl.createdby_id = creator.id LEFT JOIN m_appuser rev_by ON gl.created_date = ( SELECT MAX(gl3.created_date) FROM acc_gl_journal_entry gl3 WHERE gl3.loan_transaction_id = mlt.id ) AND gl.createdby_id = rev_by.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT cdr.client_id, MIN(addr.physical_address_sector) AS physical_address_sector, MIN(addr.physical_address_district) AS physical_address_district, MIN(addr.physical_address_cell) AS physical_address_cell, MIN(addr.state_province_id) AS state_province_id FROM m_client_address cdr JOIN m_address addr ON addr.id = cdr.address_id GROUP BY cdr.client_id ) adr ON mc.id = adr.client_id LEFT JOIN m_code_value cvp ON cvp.id = adr.state_province_id WHERE (mlt.transaction_type_enum = 2 OR mlt.transaction_type_enum = 8) AND ('${startDate}' IS NULL OR mlt.transaction_date >= '${startDate}') AND ('${endDate}' IS NULL OR mlt.transaction_date <= '${endDate}') AND ( ${officeId} = -1 OR mo.hierarchy LIKE CONCAT( IFNULL((SELECT hierarchy FROM m_office WHERE id = ${officeId}), ''), '%' ) ) AND (${paymentTypeId} = -1 OR pt.id = ${paymentTypeId}) AND ('${currencyId}' IN ('-1', '0') OR ml.currency_code = '${currencyId}') GROUP BY ml.account_no, mc.id, mo.id, mo.name, lp.name, pt.value, ml.currency_code, mlt.id, mlt.transaction_date, mlt.amount, mpd.receipt_number, mpd.routing_code, mlt.is_reversed ORDER BY mlt.transaction_date DESC

preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM stretchy_report WHERE report_name = 'Write off and Recovery Report'

update.column:
SELECT DISTINCT l.account_no AS 'Loan Number',
CASE WHEN c.legal_form_enum = 1 THEN CONCAT(c.firstname, ' ', c.lastname) WHEN c.legal_form_enum = 2 THEN c.display_name END AS 'Client Name',
st.display_name AS 'Loan Officer', p.name AS 'Loan Product', f.name AS 'Funder', cvs.code_value AS 'Strata',
loancountTbl.incremental_count AS 'Loan Cycle',
CASE WHEN c.legal_form_enum = 1 THEN cvg.code_value WHEN c.legal_form_enum = 2 THEN cvbog.code_value END AS 'Gender',
c.date_of_birth AS 'Date of Birth', coi.telephone_no AS 'Telephone',
cvp.code_value AS 'Province', adr.physical_address_district AS 'District',
currency.name AS 'Currency Type', l.disbursedon_date AS 'Disbursement Date', l.principal_disbursed_derived AS 'Disbursed Amount',
COALESCE(l.maturedon_date, l.expected_maturedon_date) AS 'Matures on',
woAgg.written_off_date AS 'Written off date', IFNULL(woAgg.total_written_off, 0) AS 'Written of amount (Total)', IFNULL(woAgg.wo_principal, 0) AS 'Written off principal', IFNULL(woAgg.wo_interest, 0) AS 'Written off interest', IFNULL(woAgg.wo_penalties, 0) AS 'Written off penalties', IFNULL(woAgg.wo_fees, 0) AS 'Written off fees',
IFNULL(recAgg.recovered_amount, 0) AS 'Recovered amount', GREATEST( IFNULL(woAgg.total_written_off, 0) - IFNULL(recAgg.recovered_amount, 0), 0 ) AS 'Written off balance', recAgg.last_recovery_date AS 'Last Recovery Date',
n.note AS 'Reason for write off',
COALESCE(TRIM(CONCAT(maker.firstname, ' ', maker.lastname)), '-') AS 'Written of By (Initiator)', COALESCE(TRIM(CONCAT(checker.firstname, ' ', checker.lastname)), '-') AS 'Written of By (Approver)'
FROM m_loan l JOIN m_client c ON c.id = l.client_id
JOIN ( SELECT lt.loan_id, MAX(lt.transaction_date) AS written_off_date, SUM(IFNULL(lt.principal_portion_derived, 0)) AS wo_principal, SUM(IFNULL(lt.interest_portion_derived, 0)) AS wo_interest, SUM(IFNULL(lt.fee_charges_portion_derived, 0)) AS wo_fees, SUM(IFNULL(lt.penalty_charges_portion_derived, 0)) AS wo_penalties, SUM(IFNULL(lt.amount, 0)) AS total_written_off FROM m_loan_transaction lt WHERE lt.transaction_type_enum = 6 AND lt.is_reversed = b'0' GROUP BY lt.loan_id ) woAgg ON woAgg.loan_id = l.id
JOIN m_office ounder ON ounder.id = ( SELECT eo.office_id FROM v_loan_entity_office eo WHERE eo.loan_id = l.id AND woAgg.written_off_date >= eo.valid_from AND woAgg.written_off_date < eo.valid_to) JOIN m_office o ON o.id = ${officeId} AND ounder.hierarchy LIKE CONCAT(o.hierarchy, '%') AND ounder.hierarchy LIKE CONCAT('${currentUserHierarchy}', '%')
JOIN m_product_loan p ON p.id = l.product_id
LEFT JOIN m_staff st ON st.id = l.loan_officer_id
LEFT JOIN m_fund f ON f.id = l.fund_id
LEFT JOIN m_currency currency ON currency.code = p.currency_code
LEFT JOIN m_client_other_info coi ON coi.client_id = c.id
LEFT JOIN m_code_value cvs ON cvs.id = coi.strata_cv_id
LEFT JOIN m_code_value cvg ON cvg.id = c.gender_cv_id
LEFT JOIN `Business Owner Information` boi ON boi.client_id = c.id LEFT JOIN m_code_value cvbog ON cvbog.id = boi.`Gender_cd_Gender`
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT cdr.client_id, MIN(addr.physical_address_district) AS physical_address_district, MIN(addr.state_province_id) AS state_province_id FROM m_client_address cdr JOIN m_address addr ON addr.id = cdr.address_id GROUP BY cdr.client_id ) adr ON adr.client_id = c.id
LEFT JOIN m_code_value cvp ON cvp.id = adr.state_province_id
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT client_id, id AS loan_id, CAST( ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY client_id ORDER BY submittedon_date ) AS SIGNED ) AS incremental_count FROM m_loan WHERE loan_status_id NOT IN (100, 400, 500) ) loancountTbl ON loancountTbl.client_id = l.client_id AND loancountTbl.loan_id = l.id
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT loan_id, id AS writeoff_txn_id FROM ( SELECT lt.loan_id, lt.id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY lt.loan_id ORDER BY lt.transaction_date DESC, lt.id DESC ) AS rn FROM m_loan_transaction lt WHERE lt.transaction_type_enum = 6 AND lt.is_reversed = b'0' ) x WHERE x.rn = 1 ) woLastTxn ON woLastTxn.loan_id = l.id
LEFT JOIN m_note n ON n.loan_transaction_id = woLastTxn.writeoff_txn_id
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT t.loan_id, SUM(IFNULL(t.overpayment_portion_derived, 0)) AS recovered_amount, MAX(t.transaction_date) AS last_recovery_date FROM m_loan_transaction t WHERE t.transaction_type_enum = 8 AND t.is_reversed = b'0' GROUP BY t.loan_id ) recAgg ON recAgg.loan_id = l.id
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT pcs.loan_id, pcs.client_id, pcs.maker_id, pcs.checker_id FROM ( SELECT pcs.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY pcs.loan_id ORDER BY pcs.made_on_date DESC, pcs.id DESC ) AS rn FROM m_portfolio_command_source pcs WHERE pcs.action_name = 'WRITEOFF' ) pcs WHERE pcs.rn = 1 ) pcsLast ON pcsLast.loan_id = l.id AND pcsLast.client_id = c.id
LEFT JOIN m_appuser maker ON maker.id = pcsLast.maker_id
LEFT JOIN m_appuser checker ON checker.id = pcsLast.checker_id
WHERE 1 = 1 AND (l.currency_code = '${currencyId}' OR '${currencyId}' = '-1') AND (IFNULL(l.fund_id, -1) = ${fundId} OR ${fundId} = -1) AND (l.product_id = '${loanProductId}' OR '${loanProductId}' = '-1') AND (IFNULL(l.loan_officer_id, -1) = '${loanOfficerId}' OR '${loanOfficerId}' = '-1') AND woAgg.written_off_date BETWEEN DATE('${startDate}') AND DATE('${endDate}') AND l.loan_status_id = 601
ORDER BY woAgg.written_off_date DESC, l.account_no
